mods.name: CNR Mod (Core)
mods.description: The core mod for Cops N Robbers. Redirects the game to the community LAN server, adds custom map loading, an in-game economy system, and a DLL mod loader that scans /sdcard/CNRMods/ on launch.

versions.changelog: Version bump to force re-download after server-side DLL replacement. Functionally identical to 2.0.44 (GetModConfig/SetModConfig config editor support).

Added in-game config editor support. GetModConfig() exposes all server.cfg fields (SERVER_IP, SERVER_PORT, MOD_VERSION, KICK_NO_MOD, APP_ID, MAP_URL, WEB_URL, ECONOMY_URL) to CNRModManager's per-mod Settings panel. SetModConfig() writes changes back to server.cfg and reloads config in-memory.

Fixed: server.cfg not created on first install. ReadConfig now creates the /sdcard/CNRMods/ directory if it doesn't exist, then writes a default server.cfg pointing at play.jacqueb.me:5055 before reading it, so the mod works out-of-the-box without manual file setup.
Players can now delete individual mail messages with a confirmation prompt. Inbox is auto-purged to 35 messages on load (oldest claimed first, then oldest no-reward unclaimed).

Removed the sync freeze that blocked equipment sync while the weapons tab was open. That workaround was added to prevent equip/unequip reverting, but the actual root cause (UICamera.useMouse double-click on profile buttons) was fixed in CNRSettingsMod 2.0.4. Equipment progression now syncs immediately regardless of which profile tab is active.
Mail unread count badge is now red instead of orange.

Disabled progression sync while the profile weapons/equipment tab is open. SyncProgression now skips if UIProfileDirector.equipmentPagePanel is active; a deferred sync fires automatically once the player leaves the tab, uploading the final loadout choice cleanly.

Fixed map selector showing every other map (again). NGUI UICamera.Notify fires OnClick on both the clicked GO and genericEventHandler, causing two OnClick calls per tap. MapNavButton now uses a per-frame pending flag: all OnClick calls within the same Update frame collapse into a single navigation increment.

Fixed SetRoomProp: instead of Activator.CreateInstance(photonHashtableType) (which may fail), now reads the room's existing customProperties Photon.Hashtable, modifies it in-place via IDictionary (confirmed working), then passes that same object to Room.SetCustomProperties. Room code does StripToStringKeys() internally so our string key CNR_MAP_URL survives. Also logs all existing room prop keys for diagnostics.

Fixed SetRoomProp write: htType.GetProperty(Item).SetValue(...) was silently failing. Switched to IDictionary indexer (same pattern confirmed working on read side). Added PublishMapUrlRetry coroutine with 10s retry loop so room prop is published even if PhotonNetwork.room is null at the moment OnLevelWasLoaded fires.

Fixed custom map loading for joining clients. Three root bugs: (1) SetRoomProp silently did nothing — GetMethod with typeof(System.Collections.Hashtable) returns null because Photon uses ExitGames.Client.Photon.Hashtable; fixed by reflecting the actual parameter type dynamically. (2) Master never called SetRoomProp — OnEnteredRoom never fires due to inRoom polling issue; fixed by calling PublishMapUrl from MapLoader.OnLevelWasLoaded when activeUrl is set. (3) TriggerClientFetch was one-shot at 3s — now polls the room prop every 0.5s for up to 25s, then falls back to HTTP.
Diagnostic: added detailed logging to GetRoomPropStr to trace exactly why CNR_MAP_URL room prop is not being read (null room, null props, wrong type, empty dict, key missing).

Fixed: TriggerClientFetch room prop read always returned null. Photon's Room.customProperties is ExitGames.Client.Photon.Hashtable, not System.Collections.Hashtable — the as-cast silently failed. Fixed by casting to IDictionary instead, which both types implement.

Fixed: joining clients fail to load custom map on devices with Android cleartext HTTP restrictions (WSA, newer Android). TriggerClientFetch now reads the CNR_MAP_URL Photon room property (set by the master at room creation) as its primary path — no HTTP required. Falls back to node-server HTTP fetch only if the room prop is absent.

Fixed: joining clients load donor map instead of custom map. FetchAndCacheMap (HTTP GET to node server) completed after MapLoader.OnLevelWasLoaded already bailed out. Fix: RedirectHook sets ModEntry.FetchingRoomMap=true before starting the fetch; MapLoader skips the vanilla bail-out while fetch is in flight; WaitAndSpawn exits early once fetch completes with no map (vanilla room).

Fixed: room creation still crashed after 2.0.14. CurSettedArmorName was already stored as empty string in PlayerPrefs from a prior 2.0.13 run; GetString() returned the stored empty value instead of the game default 'BodyArmor_1'. Now deletes the key if empty so the game default is used.

Fixed: room creation crash. ApplyProgression was writing empty string to CurSettedArmorName when server returned no armor; GrowthManger.GetCurSettedArmorInfo() threw KeyNotFoundException in CNRMultiplayerManager.Awake() causing immediate room exit. Now skips writing CurSettedArmorName if server value is empty.

Added automatic mid-session progression sync: EconomyHook now snapshots all progression keys (level, XP, weapon levels/unlocks, skins, armor, equipped slots) every 0.5s and triggers SyncProgression() after a 10s debounce whenever any key changes.

Fixed: 'Linking device...' message never updated after DoClaim completed. DoClaim now writes its result to a public static ClaimResultMsg bridge field on EconomyHook; CNRSettingsMod polls and displays it in the Account tab.
Fixed: Close and Open Mod Manager buttons in the multiplayer block dialog were not clickable. A full-screen GUI.Button was consuming all touch events before the actual buttons could receive them.
Fixed: multiplayer block dialog buttons were not clickable because OnGUI was returning early (ecoPatched=false) before drawing the dialog. Dialog now draws before the ecoPatched guard.

Reworked multiplayer block: now checks mods at the MultiplayerSelect scene boundary instead of button interception. Bounces back to MainMenu and shows a dialog if CNRModManager reports required updates pending (missing or below minVersion). Fixes the case sensitivity bug where 'MultiplayerSelect' was being navigated to as 'MultiPlayerSelect'.

Fixed: multiplayer button block now checks CNRModManager.dll in addition to CNRMod.dll and CNRSettingsMod.dll. Fixed: EcoPatchMainMenu retries up to 30 times (2-frame intervals) if NGUI buttons aren't spawned on first pass. Fixed: hook==null no longer silently bypasses the block.

Fixed: weapon unlock flags (GLOCK21, MP5KA5, UZI, etc.) now sync correctly across devices. Fixed: equipped slot/skin/armor sync uses real timestamp so last-device-to-login wins instead of always overwriting.

Multi-device account support: one account can be linked to multiple Android devices. Display name syncs from server on login — the server's canonical name is applied to all linked devices. Game progression (weapon upgrade levels, skin/armor unlocks, equipped slots, level/XP) is now synced with the server via sync.php on every login. Claim now links a new device instead of migrating (old devices stay valid).
Account recovery now requires a password (6+ chars) AND a 4-8 digit PIN. Hash is bcrypt(password+pin) with no device ID — portable across devices and eliminates multi-match collisions.

Fixed: settings and mail buttons no longer show on top of the Mod Manager overlay. Reworked mod manager interop to use a direct static field (EconomyHook.ModManagerOpen) set by CNRModManager instead of cross-DLL reflection.

Intercepts the game's built-in multiplayer button. If CNRMod.dll or CNRSettingsMod.dll are not installed on the device, tapping Multiplayer now shows a dialog listing the missing mods instead of loading the server list.
Mail and settings icons are now embedded in the DLL — no longer need settings.png / mail.png on the device.
LAN server redirect. Custom map support. Economy hook. DLL mod loader with /sdcard/CNRMods/ scanner.
Initial public release.

mods.name: CNR Settings
mods.description: Adds a settings panel accessible from the main menu and in-game. Features draggable HUD element repositioning, ADS sensitivity slider, wide camera angle toggle, full keyboard and mouse binding support, and a player account system with password+PIN recovery.

versions.changelog: Reduced jump height from ~2.5 m to ~1.3 m (JumpInitialVel 24→20). Arc feel unchanged: fast snap up, snappy fall.

Overhauled jump physics. The original arc was a clunky 5-segment constant-velocity staircase (~0.9 m peak, 1.0 s total, flat/symmetric feel). Replaced with a proper asymmetric arc: fast snap upward (~2.5 m peak in ~0.35 s) then snappy fast fall (~0.3 s), total ~0.65 s. Since position streams to all clients at 100 Hz, other players see the improved arc too.
Fixed: dragging a finger that started outside the jump button and drifting over it no longer triggers a jump. Jump now only activates for touches whose TouchPhase.Began landed on the button.

Fixed jump detection area not matching the button's actual size when resized in the HUD editor. Now uses Physics.Raycast from the NGUI camera (same method UICamera uses internally) so the hit area always matches the button's real collider regardless of scale.

Fixed intermittent first-jump delay. Instead of signalling via PlayerPrefs (which has a script execution-order race), jump detection now directly writes JoyStickController's private isJumping and jumpTime fields when grounded, firing the jump in the current frame regardless of script order. Falls back to the PlayerPrefs path when airborne (to auto-re-jump on landing).
Fixed: first jump not firing on press. Jump detection now also runs in Update() (in addition to LateUpdate) so OnJump=1 is set before JoyStickController reads it in the same frame.
Jump now fires immediately on press instead of on finger-release. Holding the jump button auto-re-jumps when the player lands.

Fixed: fire button requires two fingers to activate. Root cause: the NGUI camera viewport was being expanded to full screen, which changed the camera projection matrix. JoyStickController uses Camera.ScreenPointToRay() with Physics.Raycast to detect the FireButton collider — with the modified viewport the ray no longer intersected the collider, so one-finger fire failed silently. Fix: the camera viewport is no longer expanded. Note: HUD buttons dragged to the left quarter of the screen (outside the original NGUI camera viewport) will not respond to touches; all other positions are unaffected.
TEST BUILD: NGUI camera viewport expansion disabled to isolate one-finger fire root cause. Buttons dragged to left side of screen will not respond to touches in this build.

Fixed: fire button requires two fingers to activate. Root cause: UICamera.useMouse was forced to true on every frame, causing UICamera.ProcessMouse() to run alongside ProcessTouches() on Android. On Android, Unity's simulateMouseWithTouches maps touch[0] to mouse button 0, so ProcessMouse routed NGUI events to whatever widget was under touch[0]. When touch[0] was the fire button this NGUI processing interfered with JoyStickController's Physics.Raycast-based fire detection, causing one-finger fire to fail. With a second non-fire touch held (touch[0] elsewhere) the interference didn't hit the fire button, which is why two-finger fire still worked. Fix: useMouse is now only set to true when KBM mode is active and the cursor is visible (not locked). In all other states useMouse stays false (Android default), letting fire detection work with a single touch as intended.
Reverted 2.0.8 camera-expansion removal (that change did not address the root cause of fire issues). Restores 2.0.7 behavior while investigation continues.

Fixed fire button broken even at default button positions. Root cause: CNRSettingsMod 2.0.5 expanded the NGUI camera viewport to full screen, which changed the camera aspect ratio and shifted all Physics.Raycast hit zones — JoyStickController's fire-button raycast missed every time. The remap introduced in 2.0.6 to compensate had an accumulation bug (positions drifted further wrong on every scene reload), so even 'Reset All HUD' didn't fix it. Fix: the camera viewport is no longer expanded. JoyStickController now works correctly at all default and right-side button positions. The supplemental screen-space fire detector (TouchFireDetect) is still present but now only activates when the fire button has been explicitly dragged outside the camera viewport. Migration: on first run, any button positions saved under the expanded-camera versions (2.0.5–2.0.7) are automatically cleared so the game defaults are used.

Fixed fire button not working when the fire button is repositioned to the left side of the screen. Root cause: after the NGUI camera viewport was expanded to full-screen (2.0.5), JoyStickController's Physics.Raycast missed the fire button, so it reset PlayerLogic.mStatus to 'walk' every frame. The 2.0.6 fallback worked but couldn't persist the 'fire' state because JoyStickController overwrote it the very next Update(). Fix: the supplemental touch detector now also sets JoyStickController's private fireStatusHoldTimeCount field (via reflection) to 0.235f on each detected fire touch. This is the same mechanism JoyStickController uses internally to guard against walk resets — when holdCount > 0 its 'if (!flag && holdCount <= 0) mStatus = walk' branch is skipped, so mStatus stays 'fire' until consumed by the gun script. Cooldown is 0.2f (slightly below 0.235f) so holdCount is refreshed before it ever reaches zero while the button is held.

Fixed firing/aiming issues introduced by the 2.0.5 camera viewport expansion. Expanding the NGUI camera rect changes the camera aspect ratio, which shifts the fire button's Physics.Raycast hit zone away from its visual, causing fire to fail on the first touch and joystick touches to hit the fire collider accidentally. Fix 1 (remap): when the camera rect is expanded, each button's world position is recalculated so it projects to the exact same screen pixel as before — keeping Physics.Raycast aligned with the visual. The corrected positions are persisted so future loads need no remap. Fix 2 (fallback): a supplemental screen-space fire detector runs in LateUpdate; if any touch falls inside the fire button's projected screen bounds it directly sets the fire status, bypassing Physics.Raycast entirely as a safety net.

Fixed: HUD buttons moved to the left side of the screen with the drag editor did not respond to touches at their new position. Root cause: the game's NGUI HUD camera had its viewport rect restricted to the right portion of the screen (the virtual joystick area on the left uses a separate input system and never needed NGUI). UICamera.Raycast() rejects any touch whose ScreenToViewportPoint result falls outside [0,1], so left-side touches were silently skipped. Fix: CNRSettingsMod now expands the NGUI camera viewport to the full screen (0,0,1,1) after applying saved HUD positions, making all repositioned buttons respond correctly regardless of where they are dragged.

Fixed: equipping/unequipping weapons on the profile screen would immediately reverse itself. Root cause: UICamera.useMouse was being forced true globally (including in the main menu/profile scene), causing NGUI to fire extra OnClick events on profile buttons. useMouse is now only forced in in-game scenes where KBM input is active.

Fixed: Link Device result never appeared in the Account tab. The result was being written to EconomyHook._ecoAccountMsg (CNRMod-internal) and never reaching CNRSettingsMod's display. Now polls EconomyHook.ClaimResultMsg via reflection and copies it to the Account tab message field.

Account tab updated: Set Recovery Credentials now requires both a password (6+ chars) and a PIN (4-8 digits). Link Device (formerly Transfer Account) now requires name, password, and PIN matching the new auth scheme.
Full HUD drag-and-resize for all UI elements. KBM bindings with capture mode. ADS multiplier. Wide camera toggle (35deg / 70deg). Account PIN system.

mods.name: Mod Manager
mods.description: Browse, install, and manage DLL mods from online repositories. Tap a mod for its full description, version history, and changelogs. Supports multiple repos and works standalone even without CNR Mod installed.

versions.changelog: Fixed: Settings gear button not appearing. ReflectionTypeLoadException on game assemblies was silently aborting the entire assembly scan. Now catches ReflectionTypeLoadException and continues with partial type list. Removed strict return-type check on GetModConfig discovery. Added diagnostic logging to /sdcard/CNRMods/modmanager.log.

Per-mod Settings panel. Any installed mod that exposes GetModConfig()/SetModConfig() gets a gear button in the Installed tab. CNRMod now shows all server.cfg fields as editable text fields and toggles. Changes are written back to server.cfg on Save with a restart-required notice.
Connection error (UnknownHostException) now shows a friendly message instead of a raw Java exception.
Update banner (required installs, updates available, Install All, Quit Game) now appears in the Installed tab as well as the Browse tab.
Added HasRequiredPending static flag, read by CNRMod to gate multiplayer access. True when any mod with a minVersion is missing or below the required version.

Fixed: required mods that are not yet installed on the device are now detected and queued for install on startup (previously only already-installed mods were checked). Banner now shows in red for required installs, lists + for new installs vs arrows for updates, and cannot be dismissed while required mods are missing.

Download buttons for versions below minVersion are now disabled on both the website and the in-game version history — you can no longer manually install an outdated version that would be immediately force-updated.

Added minVersion enforcement: mods below the minimum required version are flagged in red as REQUIRED regardless of auto-update setting, and are automatically queued for update. Added CompareVersions() semver comparator.
Fixed: correctly notifies CNRMod when the overlay is opened/closed so CNRMod hides its mail and settings buttons. Adds public OpenWindow() entry point for CNRMod's multiplayer dialog.

Per-mod auto-update toggle. Startup background update check with badge counter. Update banner with one-tap batch update. Green toast notifications. Version detection with 3-tier fallback. Fixed checkbox rendering. CNRModManager itself is now self-updatable.
Initial release. Browse tab with mod list and detail pages. Version history with changelogs. latestOnly flag per mod. Multiple repo support with PlayerPrefs storage.
